title: Uruguayan Cazuela Casserole
description: A hearty Uruguayan-inspired casserole featuring crumbly speck and nourishing vegetables, perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the diced speck over medium heat until browned.
Add the chopped onions and cook until softened.
Add the sliced carrots and potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the diced chorizo and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked mixture, diced tomatoes, and Uruguayan beef broth.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
